entities.name: Rograkh
entities.description: A left-handed Kobold of Dominaria who led a resistance against his father.

entities.name: Rohgahh
entities.description: Kobold leader of Kher Keep who made himself a tyrant, imitating his god.

entities.name: Rosnakht
entities.description: Current ruler of Kher Keep, a possible descendant of Rograkh.

entities.name: Prossh
entities.description: Great dragon worshipped by the kobolds of Kher Keep as a god.

events.summary: Rohgahh decides to become a god himself, becoming a tyrant who demands tribute and sacrifice.
events.quote: he assumed the role of tyrant, demanding tribute, and sacrifice equal to what was offered to Prossh.

events.summary: Rograkh leads a resistance against his father to return the kobolds to the path of righteousness.
events.quote: He led a resistance against his father in an attempt to return the kobolds of Kher Keep to the path of "righteousness."

relations.quote: Rograkh, Rohgahh's son, could not bear to watch his father pillage his own people.
